verses.text: Open your doors, Lebanon, so that di fire go devour your cedars.
Wail, cypress tree, because di cedar don fall, because di stately ones don destroy. Wail, oaks of Bashan, because di strong forest don come down.
Di sound of di wailing of di shepherds dey, because dem glory don destroy. Di sound of di roaring of young lions dey, because di pride of di Jordan don ruin.
Di Lord my God talk say, “Feed di flock of slaughter.”
“Dem wey buy dem dey kill dem and dey hold demself as no guilty. Dem wey sell dem dey talk say, ‘Make di Lord dey blessed, because I don rich;’ and dem own shepherds no dey pity dem.”

“Because I no go pity di people wey dey live for di land again,” na so di Lord talk; “but look, I go hand over everyone into im neighbor hand and into di hand of im king; and dem go strike di land, and I no go save dem from dem hand.”
So I feed di flock of slaughter, truly di poor of di flock. I take two staffs for myself. Di one I call “Favor,” and di other I call “Union.” So I feed di flock.
I cut off di three shepherds for one month; because my soul tire of dem, and dem soul too hate me.
Den I talk say, “I no go feed una. Wetin dey die, make e die; and wetin go cut off, make dem cut am off; and make dem wey remain chop each other flesh.”
I take my staff Favor, and cut am apart, so that I go break my covenant wey I make with all di peoples.
E break for dat day; and so di poor of di flock wey listen to me know say na di Lord word.
I talk say to dem, “If una think say e good, give me my wages; and if no, keep dem.” So dem weigh 30 pieces of silver for my wages.
Di Lord talk say to me, “Throw am to di potter, di handsome price wey dem value me at!” I take di 30 pieces of silver, and throw dem to di potter, for di house of di Lord.
Den I cut apart my other staff, even Union, so that I go break di brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
Di Lord talk say to me, “Take for yourself again di equipment of foolish shepherd.”

“Because look, I go raise up shepherd for di land wey no go visit dem wey dem cut off, and no go seek dem wey scatter, and no go heal wetin break, and no go feed wetin dey healthy; but e go eat di flesh of di fat ones, and go tear dem hoofs in pieces.”
“Woe dey for di worthless shepherd wey leave di flock! Sword go dey on im arm, and on im right eye. Im arm go dry up completely, and im right eye go blind totally!”
Dis na oracle: di word of di Lord about Israel. Di Lord, wey dey stretch out di heavens, wey dey lay di foundation of di earth, and wey dey form di spirit of man inside am, talk say,
“Look, I go make Jerusalem cup of reeling to all di peoples wey dey round am, and e go dey on Judah too for di siege against Jerusalem.”
“E go happen for dat day, say I go make Jerusalem heavy stone for all di peoples. All wey burden demself with am go get serious wounds; and all di nations of di earth go gather together against am.”

“For dat day,” na so di Lord talk, “I go strike every horse with terror, and im rider with madness; and I go open my eyes on di house of Judah, and I go strike every horse of di peoples with blindness.”
“Di chieftains of Judah go talk say for dem heart, ‘Di people wey dey live for Jerusalem na my strength for di Lord of Armies, dem God.’”

“For dat day I go make di chieftains of Judah like pan of fire among wood, and like flaming torch among sheaves; and dem go devour all di peoples wey dey round dem, for di right hand and for di left; and Jerusalem go dey live again for im own place, even for Jerusalem.”
“Di Lord go also save di tents of Judah first, so that di glory of David house and di glory of di people wey dey live for Jerusalem no go dey magnified above Judah.”

“For dat day di Lord go defend di people wey dey live for Jerusalem; and di one wey dey feeble among dem for dat day go be like David; and di house of David go be like God, like di angel of di Lord before dem.”
“E go happen for dat day, say I go seek to destroy all di nations wey come against Jerusalem.”

“I go pour on di house of David, and on di people wey dey live for Jerusalem, di spirit of grace and of supplication; and dem go look to me wey dem don pierce; and dem go mourn for am, as one dey mourn for im only pikin, and dem go grieve bitterly for am, as one dey grieve for im first pikin.”
“For dat day great mourning go dey for Jerusalem, like di mourning of Hadadrimmon for di valley of Megiddo.”
“Di land go mourn, every family apart; di family of di house of David apart, and dem wives apart; di family of di house of Nathan apart, and dem wives apart;”
“Di family of di house of Levi apart, and dem wives apart; di family of di Shimeites apart, and dem wives apart;”
“All di families wey remain, every family apart, and dem wives apart.”
For dat day fountain go open to di house of David and to di people wey dey live for Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

“E go happen for dat day,” na so di Lord of Armies talk, “say I go cut off di names of di idols from di land, and dem no go remember dem again; and I go also make di prophets and di spirit of impurity pass out of di land.”

“E go happen say when anybody still dey prophesy, den im papa and im mama wey give birth to am go talk say to am, ‘You no go live; because you dey talk lies for di name of di Lord;’ and im papa and im mama wey give birth to am go stab am when e dey prophesy.”
“E go happen for dat day say di prophets go dey ashamed, everyone, of im vision, when e prophesy; dem no go wear hairy mantle to deceive;”
“But e go talk say, ‘I no be prophet, I na tiller of di ground; because dem don make me bondservant from my youth.’”
“One go talk say to am, ‘Wetin be dis wounds between your arms?’ Den e go answer, ‘Na dem wey dem wound me with for di house of my friends.’”

“Wake up, sword, against my shepherd, and against di man wey dey close to me,” na so di Lord of Armies talk. “Strike di shepherd, and di sheep go scatter; and I go turn my hand against di small ones.”
“E go happen say for all di land,” na so di Lord talk, “two parts for am go cut off and die; but di third go remain for am.”

“I go bring di third part enter di fire, and I go refine dem as dem dey refine silver, and I go test dem like dem dey test gold. Dem go call on my name, and I go hear dem. I go talk say, ‘Na my people,’ and dem go talk say, ‘Di Lord na my God.’”
Look, one day of di Lord dey come, wey dem go divide your plunder inside you.

Because I go gather all nations against Jerusalem for battle; and dem go capture di city, and loot di houses, and ravish di women; and half of di city go enter captivity, and di rest of di people no go cut off from di city.
Den di Lord go come out, and fight against dem nations, as when e fight for di day of battle.

Im feet go stand for dat day on di Mount of Olives, wey dey before Jerusalem for di east; and di Mount of Olives go split into two from east to west, to make very great valley; and half of di mountain go move toward di north, and half of am toward di south.

Una go run by di valley of my mountains, because di valley of di mountains go reach Azel; yes, una go run, just like una run from before di earthquake for di days of Uzziah king of Judah; and di Lord my God go come, and all di holy ones with una.
E go happen for dat day, say light no go dey, or cold, or frost.
E go be one day wey di Lord know; no be day, and no be night; but e go happen say for evening time light go dey.
E go happen for dat day, say living waters go flow out from Jerusalem; half of dem toward di eastern sea, and half of dem toward di western sea. E go be so for summer and for winter.
Di Lord go be King over all di earth. For dat day di Lord go be one, and im name one.

Dem go make all di land like di Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and e go dey lifted up, and e go live for im place, from Benjamin gate to di place of di first gate, to di corner gate, and from di tower of Hananel to di king wine presses.
Men go live inside am, and curse no go dey again; but Jerusalem go live safely.

Dis go be di plague wey di Lord go use strike all di peoples wey fight against Jerusalem: dem flesh go rot away while dem dey stand for dem feet, and dem eyes go rot away inside dem sockets, and dem tongue go rot away inside dem mouth.
E go happen for dat day, say great panic from di Lord go dey among dem; and dem go each seize di hand of im neighbor, and im hand go rise up against di hand of im neighbor.
Judah go also fight for Jerusalem; and di wealth of all di nations around go gather together: gold, silver, and clothing, for great abundance.
So di plague go be on di horse, di mule, di camel, and di donkey, and all di animals wey go dey for dem camps, like dis plague.
E go happen say everyone wey remain from all di nations wey come against Jerusalem go go up from year to year to worship di King, di Lord of Armies, and to keep di feast of booths.
E go be say whoever from all di families of di earth no go up to Jerusalem to worship di King, di Lord of Armies, rain no go dey on dem.
If di family of Egypt no go up, and no come, rain no go fall on dem too. Dis go be di plague wey di Lord go use strike di nations wey no go up to keep di feast of booths.
Dis go be di punishment of Egypt, and di punishment of all di nations wey no go up to keep di feast of booths.
For dat day e go dey on di bells of di horses, “HOLY TO DI LORD”; and di pots for di Lord house go be like di basins before di altar.

Yes, every pot for Jerusalem and for Judah go be holy to di Lord of Armies; and all dem wey sacrifice go come and take from dem, and cook inside dem. For dat day Canaanite no go dey again for di house of di Lord of Armies.
